_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: Your Companion Memory, on your wrist.

how.text: The watch talks only to your phone. The phone makes one authenticated call to the Memory you host.

menu-ask.text: Recall is one press. Ask offers a list of questions, or you can speak your own on watches with a microphone.

answer-error.text: The answer comes back as short lines, with a buzz. When something fails, the watch states the fact and the fix.

platforms.text: The same app runs on Aplite, Basalt, Chalk, Diorite and Emery.

keeps.text: Your last answer stays on the watch, so it is there offline. Location sync is off until you turn it on, and there is no analytics.

close.text: Recall from your wrist with Companion Memory. Visit pebble dot ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
